entities.summary: Albert R. Ferrari was an American basketball player. At 6'4", and weighing 190 lbs, he played both at guard and forward. Born in New York City, he went to high school at Brooklyn Technical High School and after he attended college at Michigan State University. He was drafted by the St. Louis Hawks in the 3rd round of the 1955 NBA draft. In his six-season NBA career, he played for the Hawks and the Chicago Zephyrs.
